CustomField.inlineHelpText: REQUIRED on any table with a row customizer or customizer Flow. Declares what that contributor reads, because reuse is decided from a fingerprint that only sees the quote and its lines. STANDARD: reads only the quote and its lines. DECLARED_DEPENDENCIES: also reads the paths in Contributor Dependency Set, which are hashed. ALWAYS_REBUILD: reads data it cannot enumerate, so reuse is skipped for the WHOLE QUOTE. Blank fails with CONTRIBUTOR_DEPENDENCY_UNDECLARED - there is deliberately no default.
CustomField.label: Cache Policy
